preconditions.description: The number of tree nodes is between 1 and 80000.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for a in range(1, n) for b in range(a + 1, n + 1) for c in range(1, n) for d in range(c + 1, n + 1) if not any(node in shortest_path(a, b) for node in shortest_path(c, d)))
postconditions.description: The result is the number of quadruples (a, b, c, d) such that the shortest paths from a to b and from c to d have no common nodes.
